# InterlockGo NOCO

> InterlockGo NOCO operates one ignition interlock service center at 3610 35th Avenue, Unit 7, Evans, Colorado 80620. The shop installs and services LifeSafer and Guardian devices for drivers from Greeley and surrounding Northern Colorado communities.

Last reviewed: July 2026

## Core services

- [Ignition interlock installation and service](https://interlockgo.io/): Local installation, scheduled calibrations, device training, and authorized removal.
- [LifeSafer devices](https://interlockgo.io/lifesafer/): Local support for the LifeSafer L250 and FC100.
- [Guardian devices](https://interlockgo.io/guardian/): Installation and service for the Guardian AMS2500.
- [Pricing estimator](https://interlockgo.io/#pricing): An estimate for the selected service interval; final charges depend on the vehicle, device, program requirements, tax, and current rate sheet.
- [Payment and assistance information](https://interlockgo.io/financing/): Current payment guidance and a link to Colorado DMV financial-assistance information.
- [Colorado interlock guide](https://interlockgo.io/getstarted/): A practical overview. The customer’s current Colorado DMV letter controls eligibility, duration, and removal requirements.
- [Guía de bloqueo de arranque en español](https://interlockgo.io/es/getstarted/): Pasos en español para preparar la instalación y seguir el proceso de restablecimiento del DMV de Colorado.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://interlockgo.io/faq/): Device, appointment, service, and Colorado program information.

## Location and service area

- Physical service center: 3610 35th Avenue, Unit 7, Evans, CO 80620.
- [Service area](https://interlockgo.io/service-areas/): Drivers visit the Evans shop from Greeley, Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, Johnstown, Longmont, Timnath, Ault, and nearby communities.
- There are no separate InterlockGo storefronts in those surrounding cities.

## Contact and hours

- Phone: [970-515-5740](tel:+19705155740)
- [Contact and directions](https://interlockgo.io/contactus/)
- [Appointment options](https://interlockgo.io/appointments/)
- Monday, Wednesday, and Friday: 8:00 AM–6:00 PM Mountain Time.
- Saturday: 8:00 AM–2:00 PM Mountain Time.
- Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday: closed.

## Important context

- InterlockGo provides installation and device service, not legal advice.
- Colorado DMV determines driver eligibility, reinstatement requirements, program duration, financial-assistance eligibility, and authorization for removal.
- Customers should follow their current DMV notice and provider instructions.
- Official program information: https://dmv.colorado.gov/ignition-interlock-program
- Official reinstatement information: https://dmv.colorado.gov/reinstatements

## Credentials

- BBB Accredited Business
- Authorized LifeSafer provider
- Guardian certified installer
